temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara sees Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough, she keeps wondering if more could have been done, and it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was a caring colleague involved in the patient's care, but she had not yet confirmed how deeply affected Shirley was by the patient's death.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara's suspicion is confirmed: Shirley is deeply affected and grieving the patient's loss.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is grieving and struggling to let go; she may benefit from comfort and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort Shirley, validate her feelings, and remind her of the good care they provided.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Shirley admits she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different treatment approach might have helped. She appreciates Sara's reassurance but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was deeply affected by the patient's death and grieving, but she did not yet know Shirley felt personally responsible for the outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara learns that Shirley is carrying guilt and second-guessing the treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels burdened by responsibility for the patient's outcome and needs help accepting that the team made the best decisions possible.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy and concern; a desire to relieve Shirley's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Shirley, discuss the treatment decisions, and encourage her not to carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley has remained reserved and minimally expressive. When confronted in the office, Shirley admits she holds back her feelings because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak, but agrees to try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knew Shirley felt responsible and was grieving, and she had observed Shirley holding back emotionally, but she was not certain why Shirley was suppressing her feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara learns Shirley is suppressing emotions due to fears of seeming unprofessional or weak, and Shirley is willing to try opening up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley needs encouragement and a safe space to express her emotions; she is at least somewhat receptive to being more open.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and compassion, with some worry about having confronted Shirley directly.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her feelings and offer friendship and support without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but accepts the apology, appreciates Sara's intent, and says they should keep talking because it helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worried that her previous confrontation might have been too harsh and could have strained their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Shirley accepts the apology and is not resentful; she values their continued conversations and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their friendship is intact, and Shirley is receptive to continued open communication and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief mixed with remorse and gratitude.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend and strengthen the friendship, continue being supportive, and avoid overstepping Shirley's boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley seems better. Shirley confirms she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support, and she agrees to spend time together outside work over the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still grieving but possibly improving, and she hoped her support was helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara learns Shirley is doing better, credits their talks and support, and is open to spending more time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is improving and receptive to deeper social support; Sara's support appears to be helping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley, plan weekend time together, and strengthen their friendship.
